sloka: अरोचयत् तद् वाक्यम् रावणो राक्षस अधिपः ।चिंतयित्वा महाबाहुः अकंपनम् उवाच ॥३-३१-३२॥
transliteration: arocayat tad vākyam rāvaṇo rākṣasa adhipaḥ ।ciṁtayitvā mahābāhuḥ akaṁpanam uvāca ॥3-31-32॥

translations.english: Ravana, the strongarmed king of demons, relished the words of Akampana and pondering over the matter, said to him :
